met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level and a north-south trough aloft at 3.1 km above mean sea level runs roughly along 92.5° E/24.8° N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Westcentral Arabian Sea between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Bihar at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southeast Arabian sea & adjoining Lakshadweep area at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The Upper air cyclonic circulation over Comorin and adjoining area at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Upper air cyclonic circulation over south coastal Andhra Pradesh and neighbourhood between 5.8 Km & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from Northwest Uttar Pradesh to north Gujarat across Rajasthan at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
